newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed up by 0.29 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 475.38 from 474.02 on Tuesday.
Volume was 786,415 dinars against 1.2 million dinars.

Detergents firm SPCD rose 0.76 dinar to 26.38 after it announced it made a 3.003 million dinars provisional net profit for 1996. Airline Tunis Air, whose passenger traffic in 1996 rose by 4.2 percent, gained 0.5 dinar to 17.5.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was up 0.33 dinar to 11.54 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole rose 0.14 dinar to 31 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat fell 0.53 dinar to 17.16 dinars.
Insurance company ASTREE was down 0.5 dinar to 34 dinars. ($= 1.06 dinars)
